starting-off.speaker: Morgan
starting-off.text: Please please help us, bold adventurer!

starting-off.speaker: Morgan
starting-off.text: Our little village has been dreadfully ravaged by an evil vampyre! He lives in the basement of the manor to the north, we need someone to get rid of him once and for all!
If the player has a combat level less than 20:

steps.player: Okay, I'm up for an adventure.

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: I think first you should seek help. I have a friend who is a retired vampyre hunter, his name is Dr. Harlow. He may be able to give you some tips. He can normally be found in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, he's a bit

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: of an old soak these days. Mention his old friend Morgan, I'm sure he wouldn't want me killed by a vampyre.

starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.speaker: Morgan
starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.text: How are you doing with the quest?

starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.speaker: Morgan
starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.text: Please hurry! Every day we live in fear that we will be the vampyre's next victim!

steps.player: His village is being terrorised by a vampyre! He told me to ask you about how I can stop it.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Buy me a beer... then I'll teash you what you need to know...

steps.player: But this is your friend Morgan we're talking about!

dr-harlow-talking-to-him-again.text: If the player isn't carrying a beer:

steps.player: I'll just go and buy one.

dr-harlow-talking-to-him-again.text: If the player is carrying a beer:

steps.text: You give a beer to Dr Harlow.

steps.player: So tell me how to kill vampyres then.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Yesh Yesh vampyres, I was very good at killing em once...
Dr Harlow appears to sober up slightly.
If the stake is in the player's inventory:

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Don't forget to take your stake with you, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off... I'd give you a stake but you've got one in your inventory.
If the stake is in the player's bank:

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Don't forget to take your stake with you, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off... I'd give you a stake but you've already got one stored somewhere.
If the player doesn't have a stake:

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Well, you're going to need a stake, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off... I just happen to have one with me.
Dr Harlow hands you a stake.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: You'll need a hammer as well, to drive it in properly, your everyday general store hammer will do. One last thing... It's wise to carry garlic with you, vampyres are somewhat weakened if they can smell garlic. Morgan

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: always liked garlic, you should try his house. But remember, a vampyre is still a dangerous foe!

attempting-to-kill-count-draynor-with-a-.text: You're unable to push the stake far enough in!

upon-killing-count-draynor.text: You hammer the stake into the vampyre's chest!
